Amateur of unique pieces, whether you are a professional (antique dealer or antique dealer) or particular, this site is for you! All ads are validated by us to ensure a quality catalog. Selency facilitates transactions through its online payment system and offers real delivery solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Selency is a community platform specialising in pre-owned furniture and decor items.

product.name: Selency Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned, vintage, antique, Scandinavian, designer, and art deco furniture and home decor.

product.name: Selency Selling Platform
product.description: A seller service for listing second-hand furniture and decor, managing a shop, processing sales, and receiving payments through Selency.

product.name: Studio Selency – Professional Interior Services
product.description: A professional service for sourcing vintage furniture, advising on decoration, managing purchases, and designing interiors for hospitality, retail, residential, and office projects.

product.name: SelencyPro Trade Program
product.description: A professional account and purchasing program that provides eligible businesses with access to professional pricing and project-oriented purchasing support.

product.name: Europe Delivery and Logistics Service
product.description: A delivery service for transporting purchased furniture and decor in Europe, including tailored delivery arrangements for large or project-based orders.

product.name: Selency Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for browsing and purchasing vintage furniture and second-hand decor through Selency on iOS and Android devices.
